title: Sample Prep for ELISA Test of Monoclonal Antibodies
author: Opentrons
materials: Mix and transfer solutions across masterblock (x4)

steps.title: Set pipette and mixing parameters
steps.instruction: Configure the robot pipettes and mixing settings as follows: set Mix repetitions and Mix volume as required; set Initial volume diluent tubes for both diluent tubes (used for liquid height tracking); set P1000 aspiration and dispense bottom clearance to 1 mm from the well bottom; set Mix height clearance to the desired height; set P1000 aspirate and dispense flow rates to the desired values; set Touch tip radius to 1.0 (100 % of well radius) and Touch tip v‑offset to –1.0 mm; set Touch tip speed to 60 mm/s (allowed range 20–80 mm/s); select the P20 pipette mount (left or right) and the P1000 pipette mount (left or right).

steps.title: Transfer diluent to antibody tubes
steps.instruction: Dispense diluent into the 300 µg/mL antibody tubes for CR3022, mAb45, and mAb269.

steps.title: Dilute antibodies to target concentrations
steps.instruction: Perform serial dilutions to bring each antibody from 300 µg/mL down to 30 µg/mL and then to 10 µg/mL.

steps.title: Dispense diluent into 96‑well block
steps.instruction: Add diluent to the following wells of the 96‑well block: A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, B1, B2, B3, B4, B5, B6, C1, C2, C3, C4, C5, C6, D1, D2, D6, E1, G1, F1, H1, E2, E3, E4, E5, F2, F3, F4, F5, G2, G3, G4, G5, H2, H3, H4, H5.

steps.title: Dispense antibodies into masterblock
steps.instruction: Add the 30 µg/mL and 10 µg/mL solutions of CR3022, mAb45, and mAb269 into the designated masterblock wells.

steps.title: Add negative control to masterblock
steps.instruction: Dispense the negative control reagent into the appropriate masterblock wells.

steps.title: Add TF control to masterblock
steps.instruction: Dispense the TF (test factor) control into the appropriate masterblock wells.

steps.title: Mix and transfer masterblock solutions
steps.instruction: Perform mixing of the masterblock solutions and transfer them across the masterblock; repeat this mixing/transfer cycle four times.

steps.title: Transfer masterblock A1‑D1 to control plates
steps.instruction: Transfer 180 µL from masterblock wells A1, B1, C1, and D1 to wells A1, C1, E1, G1 and I23, L23, M23, O23 on each of control plates 1, 2, and 3.

steps.title: Transfer masterblock A2‑D2 to control plates
steps.instruction: Transfer 180 µL from masterblock wells A2, B2, C2, and D2 to wells B1, D1, F1, H1 and J23, K23, N23, P23 on each of control plates 1, 2, and 3.

steps.title: Transfer masterblock A3‑B3 to control plates
steps.instruction: Transfer 180 µL from masterblock wells A3 and B3 to wells A2, C2 and L24, N24 on each of control plates 1, 2, and 3.
